detail: Two queries were run through OpenAlex and AnySearch Academic; cross-validated records and scope notes are retained in survey/literature_search.json.
The question was reframed from single-location search to a distributed brain-body generative-process problem.
A preregistered within-subject multimodal model-comparison design was specified with explicit nulls, controls, and causal boundaries.
The IEEEtran report was compiled with pdflatex and contains design-only claims only.
Review findings on interoceptive manipulation, preregistration specificity, source provenance, IEEE reference order, and author metadata were addressed before final compilation.
